title: Modernize frmcheckbalance Form
problem_statement: The frmcheckbalance form uses outdated VB6 controls that need to be updated to modern equivalents in C#.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of unsupported controls may lead to application instability.
suggested_approach: Replace VB6 controls with equivalent C# WinForms controls.
success_criteria: Form functions identically in C# with modern controls.
